title: Function-body caller-scope binding tripwire — same function reads a per-instance architecture signal
sourceUrl: internal: handoff §6 item 6 — function-body symbol resolution
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: `sub` declares an architecture-scope signal `k_sig` (driven from input port `kin`) and a function `add_off` that reads `k_sig` directly. Two instances of `sub` are inlined in top with different kin values (3 and 7). After elaborator renaming each instance has its own k_sig (U_u1__k_sig vs U_u2__k_sig). If the function-body cache binds Operations to the first instance's k_sig Variable and reuses them for the second call, both outputs would read the same k_sig. With per-caller cache or fresh symbol resolution: o1=5+3=8, o2=10+7=17.
